title: Rescheduling a Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery: Status, Notice, Fee and Allowance
content:
A customer may move a scheduled Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery to another date or arrival window through the level's rescheduling channels. The rule below governs which bookings can be moved, when a move is free, how many moves are allowed and which dates the new booking may take.

## The rule

1. **Status.** The booking is in scheduled status. This is read from the booking's status in the system records at the time of the reschedule, not from the customer's account of it.
2. **Notice.** A reschedule made at least the level's free notice period, in hours, before the start of the scheduled arrival window is free. A reschedule made later than that is billed the level's reschedule fee as a reschedule fee charge on the booking.
3. **Allowance.** At most the level's number of customer reschedules are made per booking.
4. **Weather and company.** Reschedules forced by severe weather or by Marlowe & Finch are free and are not counted toward that number.
5. **New date.** The new date respects the level's booking lead time, in business days, counted from the date of the reschedule.

## The status condition in brief

| Booking status shown in the records | Can the customer reschedule? |
|---|---|
| Scheduled | Yes, subject to the rule above |
| Out for delivery, delivered, failed attempt or cancelled | No |

## The notice period worked through

The clock is the start of the scheduled arrival window, and the notice is counted back from it in hours. "At least" includes the boundary: a reschedule made exactly the notice period before the window starts is free.

*Hypothetical case, free notice period of 48 hours, window starting at 10:00 on a Friday:*

| Reschedule made | Hours before the window starts | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Wednesday 09:00 | 49 | Free |
| Wednesday 10:00 | 48 | Free: exactly the notice period |
| Wednesday 11:00 | 47 | Billed the level's reschedule fee |

## Counting the allowance (hypothetical booking at a level allowing 2 customer reschedules)

| Reschedule | Cause | Counted | Customer reschedules so far |
|---|---|---|---|
| First | Customer's request | Yes | 1 |
| Second | Severe weather | No, and free | 1 |
| Third | Customer's request | Yes | 2 |

After the third line the booking has used its 2 customer reschedules.

## The new date

The earliest new date is found by counting the level's booking lead time in business days from the date the reschedule is made, not from the original booking date. With a lead time of 3 business days, a reschedule made on a given day can take the third business day after it, and not the second.
